text: Did I walk in Paris last week? No, I didn't. I walked in New York last week. Did you like the movie last night? Yes, I did. I liked it a lot. Did he work at home yesterday? No, he didn't. He worked at the office yesterday. Did she make pasta last night? No, she didn't. She made pizza last night. Did they look to the left this morning? No, they didn't. They looked to the right. Did we really cry last night? Yes, we did. Did you work out last night? Yes, we did. Did they cook last weekend? No, they didn't. They watched a movie on TV.
